claim: The same program produces bit-identical results (0 ULP drift) across CPU, GPU, WebAssembly, and in-browser execution -- floating point included.
status_detail: The discipline is publicly demonstrable in-browser today on real kernels; the exhaustive cross-substrate torture suites (six-substrate twins, 605-vector gates) live in private repositories.

evidence.note: In-browser demonstrations: one function compiled to GPU (WGSL), JavaScript, and WASM producing bit-identical outputs; webcam CPU==GPU receipts; exact correctly-rounded float summation; re-executable figures that re-derive and check themselves offline.
The determinism discipline enforced as a CI gate on the public forecasting repo: identical training regardless of global RNG state.

how_to_verify: Open the demos in your browser; the comparisons execute on YOUR hardware. The re-executable figures verify offline from a local file.
verification_record: Demos live and certified across backends including GPU; the org banner (see org-banner-re-executable) re-derived bit-identically Windows vs Linux in public CI.
limitations: Public demos cover specific kernels and the published figures. The full 0-ULP contract machinery (fixed-point spec, float-exact GPU summation, cross-backend crypto gates) is private-development; native f64 transcendentals remain excluded from the float-exact contract (vendor libm variance).
